title: Corporate Governance Tech Summit at WorkOS SF — Eric opens the day in fireside with Evan Epstein on Incorruptible
summary: Pennant and the Society for Corporate Governance (Northern California, Nevada & Hawaii Chapter) convene institutional investors, public companies and their counsel at WorkOS's San Francisco HQ. Eric opens the summit in fireside with Evan Epstein (Boardroom Governance) on the governance lessons in Incorruptible, with the day's agenda spanning DExit, AI in the boardroom, and shareholder activism. Speakers include Coinbase, Parnassus Investments, CalPERS, HPE, Cleary Gottlieb, Gibson Dunn, PJT Partners, PwC Governance Insights Center, Qatalyst, and Joele Frank.
blockquote: @adeoressi, @markpinc and @ericries Ries - Incorruptible, The Lean Startup, @ltse … every discussion lived (way) up to its billing and yielded great Q&A and follow-ups out the door in front of a packed house.
